Make a file of what you and your co-parent recorded and wrote to each other in CoPlanly — for a lawyer, a mediator or a court. It is made on this phone and goes only where you share it.

This is a record of what the parents recorded and wrote to each other in CoPlanly, and when. It is not a record of what happened, and it does not say whether anything written here is true.
Messages cannot be edited or deleted by either parent once sent. A message\'s time is the sender\'s device clock.
Every saved revision of a calendar entry is kept whole and cannot be changed afterwards. Each shows two times: when the editing parent\'s device recorded it, and when the server received it.

Entry times are the wall-clock times the parents entered, without a time zone. Expenses are shown as they stand today. Entries saved before revision history began show only their current state. Private entries and children\'s medical records are never included.

When the server can be reached, the file is registered: its record ID and a fingerprint of its exact contents are kept, so anyone holding it can check that it has not been changed. Only the fingerprint leaves this phone, never the file.
To check that this file has not been changed, open the address above and choose the file. A single changed character fails the check.
